### Traeger Announces Reporting Date for Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


October 21, 2026


SALT LAKE CITY--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Traeger, Inc. (“Traeger” or the “Company”) (NYSE: COOK), creator and category leader of the wood pellet grill, today announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results after market close on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. Management will host a conference call at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time to discuss its financial results.


Those who wish to participate in the call may do so by dialing (833) 461-5787 or +1 (585) 542-9983 for international callers, conference ID 633856685. To pre-register for the conference call, please visit[Traeger Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F633856685&esheet=54626665&newsitemid=20261021621044&lan=en-US&anchor=Traeger+Third+Quarter+2026+Earnings+Conference+Call.&index=1&md5=6e2e3fde7c25d8f2e429f169fe88895f) The conference call will also be webcast live at[https://investors.traeger.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.traeger.com&esheet=54626665&newsitemid=20261021621044&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.traeger.com&index=2&md5=683607e2f697c47cc688704001ce8f2d) .


For those unable to participate, a replay of the webcast will be available approximately two hours after the conclusion of the call on Traeger’s website at[https://investors.traeger.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.traeger.com&esheet=54626665&newsitemid=20261021621044&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.traeger.com&index=3&md5=4423d77c4f6d573961f973a0aa5b3ca1) . The replay will be available on Traeger’s website for approximately one year following the call.
